failure_patterns.pattern: missing_try_reserve: Agent failed to use try_reserve for Vec allocation with known capacity.

rejected_edits.content: Before reporting a repair as done, check the source for these recurring misses: `Vec::with_capacity` or `Vec::new` without `try_reserve` when capacity is bounded or known, unchecked `+`/`-`/`*` in capacity/length/summary math, integer `/` where `checked_div` is required by the error taxonomy, `as` width casts instead of `try_from`, unchecked `parts[i]` indexing instead of `split_once`/`get`, and production tests or manifests changed unnecessarily. Always prefer `try_reserve` over `Vec::with_capacity` when the capacity is bounded and allocation failure must be handled. Ensure all capacity/length calculations use checked arithmetic.
